information:
### Please note there will only be 2 rounds of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and no 3x3x3 Cube. 

[Silentia 2 - BLD 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Silentia2BLD2023) will be held the day after this competition.

Lunch will be provided free of charge. Competitors unable to advance to the Final round of 3x3x3 Fewest Moves must leave the competition area after the end of Round 1.
